output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is also not safe, allowing the owner to set the total supply of the token to be arbitrarily high. The mintedAmount is also not safe, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary tokens to any address.
The transfer function has a wrong logic, allowing a user to transfer tokens to a 0x0 address, causing a loss of funds.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is of uint256 type, allowing it to overflow and become a very large number, causing a loss of funds.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is of uint256 type, allowing it to overflow and become a very large number, causing a loss of funds.
